sentences.en: Sometimes the boys would play a trick on their teacher.
sentences.zh: 有时候那些男孩会捉弄他们的老师。

sentences.en: He got money from the old woman by a trick.
sentences.zh: 他用诡计从那位老太太那儿骗来了钱。

sentences.en: You won't trick her; she knows a thing or two.
sentences.zh: 你休想蒙混过关；她知道不少事情。

senses.zh: 诡计；恶作剧；窍门；花招；骗局；欺诈
特技的；欺诈的；有决窍的
